description: Registry of Adaptation Practitioners is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EcoAdapt; Climate Resilience Fund; Geos Institute. The Registry of Adaptation Practitioners is an online guided directory of vetted adaptation service providers. The Registry enables communities and organizations seeking climate adaptation support services to easily find practitioners whose expertise and focus match their needs. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Multiple or All Hazards. Assets: Multiple or All Assets. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
